decision.reason: All retained complete force calls and directional differences pass independent numerical/residual gates; native CPU/CUDA, exact-budget/fallback/refusal, 44 public regressions and sanitizer receipts are retained. No 56-AO historical speedup claimed.

reproduction.instructions: In an isolated checkout of the exact parent, apply gzip -dc source.patch.gz | git apply exactly once, then gzip -dc qualification.patch.gz | git apply exactly once. The second patch restores the final test/fixture/reproducer files and a header comment, without changing scientific executable code. Build Release CUDA12.9.1 sm_120 with fast_compile=false and explicit CXX/CUDA ccache launchers plus checkout-root CCACHE_BASEDIR. Use Slurm main gpu:pro6000:1 on n2, finite time limits, preserve CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; set CPU library threads=1, GENERATIVEQC_LIBRARY, PYTHONPATH=python:. and a unique GENERATIVEQC_DF_PROGRESS_TRACE. Every cold/warm/repeat/changed row must pass pinned energy 3e-9, triples 2e-9, force 1e-6 and response 1e-9 gates. Direction uses RNG155214, mean-free normalized shape(24,3), steps4e-4/2e-4/1e-4; near geometry adds1e-9 bohr to atom1 z. Run generativeqc_triples_fock_response_tests with/without --cuda, host resources and public CC suites with CUDA opt-in. Unfiltered memcheck for native and methane; focused56 uses kernel-name kns=triples_resolvent/triples_oo_moment/triples_vv_moment/add_occupied/add_virtual, repeated options. Four AB/BA paired processes for atoms6/12 compare #1748. Regenerate methane independently with benchmarks/ccsdt_degenerate_oracle.py, PySCF2.14.0. Gzip members decode as UTF-8 JSON or unified patch; no numerical rounding.
